name: NetworkManager.service
commands: ExecReload=/usr/bin/busctl call org.freedesktop.NetworkManager /org/freedesktop/NetworkManager org.freedesktop.NetworkManager Reload u 0

name: bazzite-libvirtd-setup.service
commands: ExecStart=/usr/bin/bash -c "systemctl enable --now libvirtd; restorecon -Rv /var/log/libvirt /var/lib/libvirt; systemctl disable %n"

name: cockpit-container.service
commands: ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --name cockpit-ws --replace --rm --cgroups=split --sdnotify=conmon -d -v /:/host --env NAME=cockpit-ws --label io.containers.autoupdate=registry --privileged --pid=host --cgroups=split quay.io/cockpit/ws:latest /container/label-run

name: nfs-server.service
commands: ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c 'if systemctl -q is-active gssproxy; then systemctl reload gssproxy ; fi'

name: selinux-check-proper-disable.service
commands: ExecStart=/usr/bin/echo 'SELINUX=disabled in /etc/selinux/config, but no selinux=0 on kernel command line - SELinux may not be fully disabled. Please update bootloader configuration to pass selinux=0 to kernel at boot.'

name: systemd-ask-password-wall.service
commands: ExecStartPre=-systemctl stop --no-block systemd-ask-password-console.path systemd-ask-password-console.service systemd-ask-password-plymouth.path systemd-ask-password-plymouth.service

name: unbound-anchor.service
commands: ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'if [ "$DISABLE_UNBOUND_ANCHOR" = "yes" ] || [ -f /run/unbound/anchor-disable ]; then echo "Updates of root keys with unbound-anchor is disabled"; else /usr/sbin/unbound-anchor $UNBOUND_ANCHOR_OPTIONS; fi'

name: podman-user-wait-network-online.service
commands: ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'until systemctl is-active network-online.target; do sleep 0.5; done'
